title: You're On Mute
style: gospel pop, 96 BPM, hammond organ, full gospel choir backing vocals, soulful female lead, communal handclaps, tambourine, building anthem with testimony spoken bridge, joyful comedic crescendo
lyrics:
[Intro — solo gospel piano, distant Zoom join sound, female lead]
I had so much to say
The words were pure as gold

[Verse 1 — female, soulful]
I prepared my speech for two whole weeks
I rehearsed every breath, every word that I'd speak
The CEO was watching, the team was all there
I leaned to the camera with so much to share

[Pre-Chorus — choir backing enters]
I poured out my heart for two and a half minutes
A vision so bright it could power the kingdoms
I closed with conviction, I waited for the praise
And then I saw the screen of all my colleagues face

[Chorus — full gospel choir, hands raised]
You're on mute! You're on MUTE!
The greatest speech that nobody heard
You're on mute! You're on MUTE!
Two minutes of silence, not a single word
You're on mute! You're on MUTE!
The icon was red, you were rendered absurd
You're on MUTE!

[Verse 2 — female]
I tried it again with the microphone hot
I gave them the highlights of what they had not got
But the magic was gone, the spark was no more
The first take was holy, this one was a chore

[Pre-Chorus]
The Zoom giveth and the Zoom taketh away
Your finest hour erased in one day
The mute button laughs from its corner of red
You delivered the speech but you might as well be dead

[Chorus — full gospel choir]
You're on mute! You're on MUTE!
The greatest speech that nobody heard
You're on mute! You're on MUTE!
Two minutes of silence, not a single word
You're on mute! You're on MUTE!
The icon was red, you were rendered absurd
You're on MUTE!

[Bridge — choir hum, spoken testimony]
[deacon voice] Brothers and sisters
We gather to mourn the lost speeches of two thousand and twenty-six
The promotions denied
The bonuses withheld
All because of a small red icon
Let us pray

[Outro — choir crescendo]
You're on mute! You're on MUTE!
But the Lord above heard every word
You're on mute! You're on MUTE!
Hallelujah, you're on mute!
